meta.title: WasteLoop — surplus food and organic waste exchange
meta.description: WasteLoop connects people with surplus food and organic waste to farmers, energy plants, recyclers and charities who can use it.

footer.platformNotice: WasteLoop is a connection and coordination platform only. It does not operate vehicles, hold funds, certify food safety or process waste.

foodSafety.notice: WasteLoop does not certify food safety. Check the condition of the food in person before you accept it.

q1.question: What is the best thing to do with leftover cooked rice that is still good to eat?
q1.a: Give it to a community kitchen
q1.why: Edible food should feed people first. Compost and energy come after.

q2.question: What can a biogas plant do with used cooking oil?
q2.a: Nothing — it has to go to landfill
q2.why: Used oil and organic waste are good feedstock for biogas and biodiesel.

q3.question: Which plastic do recyclers pay the most for?
q3.why: Clean, sorted plastic fetches the best price. Rinse it and keep types separate.
